security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU TCG does not deposit the trapping instruction's code-page PTE.MTAG bit into mstatus.MTAG_I (M-mode trap) or hstatus.MTAG_I (HS-mode trap) during trap entry when mtinst/htinst is written with a nonzero value, OR QEMU does not consult these bits when deciding whether HLV/HSV and MPRV loads/stores generate memory tagging checks.
security_spec.summary: New CSR bits mstatus.MTAG_I and hstatus.MTAG_I must be deposited from code-page PTE during trap entry and consumed by HLV/HSV/MPRV tag-check logic; missing either side-effect breaks hypervisor-guest and MPRV memory-tag isolation, allowing guest-triggered tag bypass or spurious tag faults across privilege boundaries.
